data.one_liner: Image message widget for Flutter chat apps with cross-platform caching, BlurHash, and ThumbHash.
data.what_it_does: Provides an opinionated image message widget that complements the flutter_chat_ui ecosystem. It handles cross-platform image caching, displays upload and download progress indicators, and supports loading placeholders like Blurhash or Thumbhash.
use_when: You are building a chat application using the flutter_chat_ui ecosystem
You need cross-platform image caching for chat image messages
You want built-in BlurHash or ThumbHash placeholders while full images load
avoid_when: You need a standalone general-purpose image loading or picking widget
You are not using the flutter_chat_ui or flutter_chat_core packages
strengths: Built-in upload and download progress indicators
Supports Blurhash and Thumbhash loading placeholders
weaknesses: Not intended for standalone use outside the Flyer Chat ecosystem
Requires specific companion packages from the Flyer Chat suite
data.setup_notes: Add the package alongside flutter_chat_ui in your pubspec.yaml file and use it within the Chat widget builders.
